It establishes that hidden middle effect drift and explicit middle-local dependency drift do not silently mutate top currentness; the top stales only after its own actual request outcomes contradict the learned effect relation. Effect-preserving hidden middle phenotype change remains current at both layers.
observed: Hidden middle effect-flip changed no top or middle capability signature and both learned relations remained current before post-drift world contact.
